description: Session conduct for the product plugin. SessionStart injects the voice rules (audience register, no procedure narration, the confirmation line) so they bind even when a session never opens issue-tracker.md — sessions consult that doc on demand (often grepping one line), so conduct rules placed only there provably miss. Canonical text stays in the product-config skill's Voice section (and 'No write without a yes' in its issue-tracker.md); the hook is the delivery channel, not the source of truth. Fails open: it only echoes static text.
